name: react-19-docs
description: Hand-built static documentation site for React 19.

scripts.verify: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/check-examples.mjs

//: The site build (scripts/build.mjs) has NO dependencies and runs on a fresh clone with no install. These devDependencies exist only so scripts/check-examples.mjs can type-check every documentation example against the real React 19 packages, and every Next.js example against the real next@16.3.5 (plus zod, drizzle-orm, server-only and Playwright types). node_modules/next/dist/docs is also the version-matched reference Next.js pages are written against.
